_comment: Every config value The Great Journey changes from a mod's own default, and why. tools/apply_config_choices.py applies these to the defaults the mods generate (build/config-defaults, from a clean server boot) and writes only these files into pack/overrides/config. No config is inherited from any other pack. Keys are 'section' + 'key' exactly as in the generated TOML.

config/dynamicwaters-common.toml.why: Dynamic Waters' mountain-river planning held new-world creation for many minutes

config/warriorcats_events-server.toml.why: new cats begin where The Great Journey's start puts them (kittypet garden, Clan camp or lake shore), not at a random biome
the four Clans hold the whole lake map; kittypets, loners and visitors can still build and dig there (the territory HUD still shows whose land it is)

config/warriorcats_events-prey_items.tom.why: prey from the pack's wildlife mods feeds a cat like Warrior Cats Events' own prey (docs/clanwild.md)

config/alexsmobs-common.toml.why: Every new player started holding the Animal Dictionary, and right-clicking a Clan cat with it opens the dictionary instead of talking to the cat (found by the playtest harness). The guide and journal are The Great Journey's books.
animals from other continents do not live in the Clans' woods and moors; crows, seagulls, fish and the ocean, Nether and End creatures keep their spawns

config/Weather2/Tornado.toml.why: no tornadoes or hurricanes tearing up the territories; rain, thunder, wind and storms stay

config/sereneseasons/seasons.toml.why: At Serene Seasons' default of 8 days a sub-season, a whole season passed in 24 days and the leaves changed colour every 8 days, far too fast for a Clan's moons (playtest). 24 days a sub-season makes a season 72 days.
